definition.primary: AUROC posterior - AUROC best open-source baseline (selected on the selection worlds at checkpoint 16), set gen_obs, focused_sample evidence, checkpoint 16, test worlds
definition.decision: posterior better if the 95% lower end is above 0; baseline better if the 95% upper end is below 0; otherwise equivalent if the 90% interval lies inside (-0.03, 0.03); otherwise inconclusive

S1.prediction: random_omit evidence: posterior better than its selected baseline
S1.test: decision on posterior - observer (AUROC), predicted posterior better

S2.prediction: maximal evidence on generated worlds: exactly 0.5 AUROC for every method except arms; arms 0.5 in expectation
S2.test: every per-world value exactly 0.5; 95% interval of arms - 0.5 contains 0

S3.prediction: observer equals sam in every cell

S4.prediction: F1: posterior above the best baseline
S4.test: 95% interval of posterior - observer entirely above 0 (f1)

S5.prediction: acting cost ratio: posterior below (cheaper than) the best baseline
S5.test: 95% interval of posterior - observer entirely below 0 (act_ratio)

S6.prediction: posterior - pair_weight equivalent within the margin
S6.test: decision on posterior - pair_weight (AUROC), predicted equivalent

S7.prediction: goal-only: posterior - pair_weight equivalent within the margin
S7.test: decision on posterior - pair_weight (AUROC), predicted equivalent
